appearance.organs.flower.shape.centre.note: The ovary a pale yellow-green bead at the flower's centre, about a sixth of the flower across (observations 212349274, 205778790, 224881574).

appearance.organs.flower.shape.pistil.note: The ovary a pale yellow-green bead at the flower's centre, about a sixth of the flower across (observations 212349274, 205778790, 224881574): about sRGB (190, 220, 130).

traits.anther_attachment.note: The anthers lie across the filaments' tips, like a T, not along them (observations 212349274, 115789029, 116021043, 256853681): versatile, as Simpson's Plant Systematics defines the word (the anther joined at one point on its back and swinging free).

generator.params.fruit_area.note: The area a spent flower drawn as a closed perianth covers on an organ 1 m long, measured on its drawing, so its shade matches what it draws.

generator.params.basal_arch.note: Leaves rise steeply from the base and arch outward in their upper half, reaching about a third to half the scape's height (observations 116021043, 151395471, 6126457).

generator.params.basal_angle.note: Leaves rise steeply from the base and arch outward in their upper half, reaching about a third to half the scape's height (observations 116021043, 151395471, 6126457).

generator.params.basal_leaves.note: Four to eight basal leaves round the scape (observations 116021043, 151395471): six drawn.

generator.params.stems.note: Each bulb sends up one flowering scape (observations 256854545, 29355728, 6126457, 116021043 and the budding photographs): the plant is drawn as one bulb.

appearance.organs.fruit.note: Below the open flowers the spent ones keep their withered tepals, closed and twisted round the young capsule, in a dull violet-grey to olive (fruiting and flowering photographs in project notes, e.g. observations 256853681 and 43531696): drawn as a closed perianth in that colour, about as long as a bud.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.anther.note: Anthers long yellow bars, about a third as long as the filaments (observations 212349274, 115789029, 116021043).

appearance.organs.flower.shape.taper.note: Tepals narrowly elliptic, widest a little above the middle, their sides curving to an acute tip rather than straight to a point (observations 212349274, 205778790, 115789029).

appearance.bark.note: The scape dark green, often tinged purple, darker than the leaves (observations 116021043, 256854545, 29355728, and the budding and fruiting photographs in project notes): about sRGB (60, 85, 55).

generator.params.flower_area.note: The area an open flower covers on an organ 1 m long, measured on its drawing (narrow tepals, the lowest bent down), so its shade matches what it draws.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.filament.note: The filaments blue-violet like the tepals, a little paler, with the yellow anthers at their tips (observations 212349274, 224881574, 115789029).

appearance.organs.flower.shape.turn.note: Photographs of open flowers (observations 212349274, 256854545, 205778790, 116021043): five tepals spread up and to the sides and the lowest stands apart, bent out and down, so most flowers are symmetric about one plane; some are nearly regular (52750451, 43531696). The odd tepal is as wide as the rest. Drawn as an unequal corolla turned half round, its odd tepal below and bent 40 degrees out from the others.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.odd_rise.note: Photographs of open flowers (observations 212349274, 256854545, 205778790, 116021043): five tepals spread up and to the sides and the lowest stands apart, bent out and down, so most flowers are symmetric about one plane; some are nearly regular (52750451, 43531696). The odd tepal is as wide as the rest. Drawn as an unequal corolla turned half round, its odd tepal below and bent 40 degrees out from the others.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.banner.note: Photographs of open flowers (observations 212349274, 256854545, 205778790, 116021043): five tepals spread up and to the sides and the lowest stands apart, bent out and down, so most flowers are symmetric about one plane; some are nearly regular (52750451, 43531696). The odd tepal is as wide as the rest. Drawn as an unequal corolla turned half round, its odd tepal below and bent 40 degrees out from the others.

traits.zygomorphy.note: The same flowers: one tepal set apart, no lips, banner or keel, so a zygomorphy of no named kind.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Photographs of open flowers (observations 212349274, 256854545, 205778790, 116021043): five tepals spread up and to the sides and the lowest stands apart, bent out and down, so most flowers are symmetric about one plane; some are nearly regular (52750451, 43531696). The odd tepal is as wide as the rest. Drawn as an unequal corolla turned half round, its odd tepal below and bent 40 degrees out from the others.

generator.params.bud_area.note: The area a bud drawn as a closed flower covers on an organ 1 m long, measured on its drawing, so its shade matches what it draws.

appearance.organs.flower.shape.point.note: Tepals acute, narrowing over their outer third to a point (observations 212349274, 52750451, 205778790).

appearance.organs.flower.shape.stamen_le.note: Six spreading stamens about half the flower's radius long, their anthers bright yellow and conspicuous (observations 212349274, 256854545, 256853681, 116021043).

appearance.organs.flower.accent.note: The anthers long bars of pale lemon yellow, about sRGB (240, 225, 95) (observations 212349274, 115789029, 116021043, 256853681).

appearance.organs.flower.colour.note: Open flowers pale to deep blue-violet; drawn at the middle of the photographs (observations 212349274, 151395471, 256854545, 205778790), about sRGB (130, 120, 210).

appearance.organs.flower.shape.petal_wid.note: Tepals about a fifth to a quarter as wide as long (0.15 to 0.25; observations 212349274, 52750451, 205778790); with the elliptic taper the drawn tepal is about that, neighbours a little apart in a star.

appearance.organs.bud.note: A bud is the closed perianth: six tepals folded into a narrow point, darker and greyer blue-violet than the open flowers (observations 256854545, 115789029, 29355728, 116021043).

generator.params.fruit_length.note: A spent flower with its withered tepals is about as long as a bud (the same photographs).

generator.params.flower_angle.note: Photographs of flowering racemes (observations 151395471, 256853681, 43531696): open flowers on short ascending stalks, about half to one tepal long, held close to the axis so the open part of the raceme is dense.

generator.params.pedicel.note: Open flowers on ascending stalks about one to two centimetres long (observations 205778790, 151395471, 43531696); a model judging photographs and renders found the photographs' stalks longer than the renders' (image-data pilot, 2026-10-14).

generator.params.bud_size.note: Photographs of flowering racemes (observations 256854545, 115789029, 29355728, 6126457, 116021043): the unopened buds, nearly half the raceme's flowers, stand packed in a tight cone at its tip, each erect and nearly pressed to the axis, narrow and pointed, about four to five times as long as wide and about half a tepal long; the spacing, stalk and angle are set to draw that.

generator.params.flowers.note: Buds, flowers and fruit on one raceme, counted on photographs of flowering plants: 15 to 40, about 25 (observations 116021043, 151395471, 256853681, 43531696).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Quamasia quamash: stems 20 cm to 60 cm tall. The scan's text reads cm, which the plant's own parts show is a misreading of dm. The typical value is the one the plant was drawn at before, inside the source's range.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a bulb with a few grass-like basal leaves and a leafless stem carrying a loose raceme of star-shaped, deep blue-violet flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.5 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: grey-green leaves; blue-violet flowers. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): six blue tepals in two whorls, six stamens and a superior pistil of three carpels, from the characters of Asparagaceae by the rules at the flowering plants.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
